verdicts.evidence: The condition checks whether the download command succeeded and whether the output file exists, and only then runs PowerShell Start-Process on that file; this is an install-time gate on file availability, so `not_environmental` does not fit (s1, f1:15-20).

The if statement gates the Start-Process call on a successful download return code and the output file's existence, so it decides whether the downloaded executable is opened during install and is an environmental availability check (s2, f1:15-25).
